title: 概率应用题
summary: 根据男女人数倍数关系求抽到女生的概率
scene_svg:
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="inkGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fdfbf7"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fee2e2"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="redGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8a1c1c"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b53a3a"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#1f2937" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
  </filter>
  <filter id="glowRed" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
    <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="0" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#8a1c1c" flood-opacity="0.35"/>
  </filter>
  <style>
    .ink { fill:#1f2937; font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; }
    .mid { fill:#44403c; font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; }
    .soft { fill:#78716c; font-family: Arial, 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; }
    .stroke-ink { stroke:#1f2937; }
    .stroke-mid { stroke:#44403c; }
    .stroke-soft { stroke:#78716c; }
    .dashed-line { stroke-dasharray: 8 8; }
    .floaty { animation: floaty 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .pulse { animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .shine { animation: shine 2.8s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes floaty { 0%,100%{ transform:translateY(0px);} 50%{ transform:translateY(-8px);} }
    @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{ transform:scale(1);} 50%{ transform:scale(1.05);} }
    @keyframes shine { 0%{ opacity:.35;} 50%{ opacity:1;} 100%{ opacity:.35;} }
  </style>
</defs>

<g>
  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 1" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-6" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0" x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-700" x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100" x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0">
    <rect x="70" y="70" width="300" height="170" rx="22" fill="url(#inkGrad)" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="100" y="115" class="ink" font-size="28" font-weight="700">总人数：48 人</text>
    <text x="100" y="160" class="mid" font-size="22">女生 = 男生的 3 倍</text>
    <text x="100" y="200" class="soft" font-size="18">先把“份数”想清楚</text>
    <circle cx="330" cy="145" r="22" fill="#8a1c1c" filter="url(#glowRed)" class="pulse"/>
    <text x="322" y="152" font-size="20" fill="#fff">?</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 2" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100" x-transition:leave="transition ease-in duration-700" x-transition:leave-start="opacity-100" x-transition:leave-end="opacity-0">
    <rect x="440" y="70" width="290" height="170" rx="22" fill="#fdfbf7" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="470" y="110" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">男生：1 份</text>
    <text x="470" y="150" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">女生：3 份</text>
    <text x="470" y="192" class="mid" font-size="20">共 4 份</text>
    <path d="M560 98 C600 80, 640 80, 680 98" fill="none" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="2" class="dashed-line"/>
    <path d="M560 138 C600 120, 640 120, 680 138" fill="none" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="2" class="dashed-line"/>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 3" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-x-8" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-x-0">
    <rect x="120" y="290" width="560" height="110" rx="18" fill="#fdfbf7" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="145" y="325" class="mid" font-size="22">把 48 人平均分成 4 份：</text>
    <text x="405" y="325" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">48 ÷ 4 = 12</text>
    <text x="145" y="365" class="mid" font-size="22">1 份 = 12 人</text>
    <line x1="170" y1="388" x2="630" y2="388" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="2" class="dashed-line"/>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 4" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <g transform="translate(120,430)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="120" height="70" rx="16" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="25" y="30" class="mid" font-size="20">男生</text>
      <text x="38" y="56" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">12 人</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(280,430)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="120" height="70" rx="16" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#glowRed)"/>
      <text x="25" y="30" class="mid" font-size="20">女生</text>
      <text x="38" y="56" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">36 人</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(440,430)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="120" height="70" rx="16" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#44403c" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="31" y="30" class="mid" font-size="20">合计</text>
      <text x="38" y="56" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">48 人</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" class="floaty">
    <circle cx="205" cy="545" r="18" fill="#8a1c1c" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="205" cy="545" r="8" fill="#fdfbf7"/>
    <text x="235" y="552" class="mid" font-size="22">女生占 36 人</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 5" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-800" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-4" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <path d="M250 520 C320 470, 360 470, 430 520" fill="none" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="3" class="dashed-line shine"/>
    <path d="M250 528 C320 478, 360 478, 430 528" fill="none" stroke="#78716c" stroke-width="2" class="dashed-line"/>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 6" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-1000" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-90" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <rect x="520" y="290" width="200" height="170" rx="20" fill="url(#inkGrad)" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="545" y="332" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">概率 = 女生人数</text>
    <text x="545" y="365" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">÷ 总人数</text>
    <text x="545" y="410" class="ink" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#8a1c1c">= 36 ÷ 48</text>
    <text x="545" y="447" class="ink" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#8a1c1c">= 3/4</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 7" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 translate-y-6" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 translate-y-0">
    <rect x="70" y="470" width="320" height="86" rx="18" fill="#fdfbf7" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="96" y="505" class="ink" font-size="24" font-weight="700">答案：选到女生的概率 = 3/4</text>
    <text x="96" y="538" class="soft" font-size="18">也就是 75%</text>
  </g>

  <g x-show="sceneStep >= 8" x-transition:enter="transition ease-out duration-900" x-transition:enter-start="opacity-0 scale-95" x-transition:enter-end="opacity-100 scale-100">
    <rect x="430" y="470" width="300" height="86" rx="18" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#8a1c1c" stroke-width="2" filter="url(#glowRed)"/>
    <text x="454" y="504" class="ink" font-size="22" font-weight="700">检验：3/4 × 48 = 36</text>
    <text x="454" y="538" class="mid" font-size="18">与“女生 36 人”一致，结果正确</text>
  </g>
</g>
